proposal.reason: Main change is in transport/P2P connection setup: stream synchronization pairing, connect-progress accounting, P2P connect gating, and IPC address return behavior in src/transport.cc and src/transport/p2p.cc. Additional memory review is needed because shared-memory resource ownership semantics were substantively changed (new handle-based shm open/close API, refcounted attach/unlink lifecycle, and shareable buffer allocate/import/close interfaces in src/include/shm.h, src/misc/shmutils.cc, and src/transport/shm.cc).
